recommendation: Keep this source fix. It removes the stale active example wording without broadening the issue into invariant-test fixtures or adding redundant DiagnosticReport guidance that OO later considered adequate.
issue_request: FHIR-9433 was a Published FHIR-core OO change request for Observation.issued and DiagnosticReport.issued. The final Persuasive with Modification disposition approved clarified wording so the issued elements describe when this version was made available, with an update-time clarification link rather than an original release-date interpretation.
initial_application: The issue was applied upstream in commit 2bc0950a1e354c2a99db1fca80954166c25bc241, whose message included #9433. That commit changed DiagnosticReport and Observation spreadsheet sources: DiagnosticReport.issued moved from release-from-source wording to made-available-to-providers wording, and Observation.issued gained this-version wording plus the lastUpdated/update-time clarification. The current base StructureDefinition XML preserves those changes.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport, Observation, and StructureDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-31956 changed DiagnosticReport.issued from instant to dateTime and stated that the existing DiagnosticReport.issued definition and comments adequately address the guidance request; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch and was not decided again. The only remaining build-scoped stale wording found outside test fixtures was in source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-example.xml.
reconciliation: Changed source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-example.xml so the DiagnosticReport.issued profile example uses the same short and definition as the current base DiagnosticReport.issued. No change was made to the base Observation or DiagnosticReport definitions because they already reflect FHIR-9433 and later context.
